name: Arcane Safeguard

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepared: Resistance; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting. Help assisting an ally’s ability check also grants that ally Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Resistance may be cast as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest; alternate casting is not automated.
